title: EsSA truck mechanic repaired damaged suspensions

tellings.quote: I have a really interesting point that I want to make quickly because I just talked to allegedly the mechanic who worked on the trucks >> that this was the mechanic for the trucks as a military base and he said that he had to make all these extensive repairs on the suspension at that time

plain: A documentary filmmaker named James Fox says he spoke with a man said to be the truck mechanic at a Brazilian military base known as EsSA in 1996. According to Fox, the mechanic said he had to make extensive repairs to the trucks' suspensions at that time, which Fox raises because it would suggest the trucks carried something unusually heavy linked to a reported alien case that year.
